# testdata — SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDERS

> **WARNING: All fixtures in this directory are SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDERS.**
> They are generated, representative data for development and CI testing purposes.
> **They MUST be replaced with real forgeseal/svidmint artifacts before v0.1 ships.**
> See §8 of the project SDD and tasks 1.4 and 1.7 for the real signing pipeline.

## Test Image Reference

| Constant | Value |
|---|---|
| `TestImageName` | `ghcr.io/sns45/example:1.0.0` |
| `TestImageDigest` | `sha256:e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855` |

The digest above is `sha256(empty-string)` — a stable, well-known placeholder.
Real image digests will be supplied by the image build pipeline.

## Fixture Files

Each fixture is a DSSE envelope (JSON) with:
- `payloadType`: `application/vnd.in-toto+json`
- `payload`: base64-standard-encoded in-toto Statement v1 JSON
- `signatures`: placeholder `[{"keyid":"","sig":""}]` — no real crypto

### SLSA Provenance

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `slsa/valid-l3.dsse.json` | Happy-path SLSA Build L3 provenance; subject digest matches `TestImageDigest`. |
| `slsa/digest-mismatch.dsse.json` | Negative test: subject digest is all-`a`s and does NOT match `TestImageDigest`. |

#### How SLSA Level Is Derived From the Predicate

The `valid-l3.dsse.json` fixture is shaped to be consistent with SLSA Build L3
under the [SLSA v1.0 specification](https://slsa.dev/spec/v1.0/levels):

- `predicateType` is `https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1` (SLSA v1 provenance schema).
- `runDetails.builder.id` is a fully-qualified HTTPS URI pointing to a hosted
  builder (`https://github.com/sns45/ci`). A hosted, isolated builder is a
  prerequisite for L3.
- `runDetails.builder.builderDependencies` is an empty array, meaning the builder
  itself has no unverified external inputs at build time (L3 requirement).
- `buildDefinition.buildType` identifies the exact build system used.

In production the L3 determination is cryptographically anchored by the
Sigstore bundle produced by forgeseal (task 1.4). The fixture only tests that
the policy engine can parse and act on the predicate fields; it cannot substitute
for a real Sigstore verification.

### VEX

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `vex/affected-critical.dsse.json` | OpenVEX v0.2.0 document; `CVE-2024-0001` status `affected`, no justification. Used for negative/critical-finding tests. |
| `vex/not-affected.dsse.json` | OpenVEX v0.2.0 document; same CVE, status `not_affected`, justification `vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path`. Used for positive/mitigated-vuln tests. |

## Generator

Run from the repository root to regenerate all fixtures:

```bash
go run testdata/gen/main.go
```

The generator source is `testdata/gen/main.go` (tagged `//go:build ignore` so it
is never compiled as part of the module).

## Crypto Fixtures (Not Here)

Real Sigstore bundles and signed SVIDs are produced by tasks 1.4 (forgeseal) and
1.7 (svidmint). Those artifacts are NOT generated by `testdata/gen/main.go`.
